title: Automate the admin so your attorneys stay on billable work.

blocks.text: Automate the admin so your attorneys stay on billable work.
Intake, document drafting, billing, and client updates run in the background. Partners keep judgment calls. Your data stays in your environment.
Teams we ship for
The stack we ship on
Engineers stopped being the bottleneck.
The bottleneck moved to orchestration. Claude Code is the brain, MCP plugs into your stack, E2B sandboxes every action. One of our engineers ships like three normal hires.

Intake that catches every lead, day or night
Missed calls are lost retainers. We capture inquiries from your site, voicemail, and email, run conflict checks, qualify the matter, and book a consult, all before an attorney touches it.
Conflict checks on autopilot
New prospects get screened against your matter database the moment they fill the intake form. Clean leads move forward, flagged ones go to a partner.
One CRM for the whole firm
Marketing, intake, and case management share one record. No re-keying client info into Clio, MyCase, or PracticePanther.
Client updates that go out without a partner writing them
Long cases die from silence. We trigger status updates, check-ins, and document requests from your case management software so clients stay informed.
Same-hour replies
New inquiries get an answer in minutes, drafted from your firm's voice and reviewed before send.
Quiet-case check-ins
Automatic touchpoints during long matters so clients never feel forgotten between filings.
Source tracking
See which referrals, ads, and SEO pages bring matters that actually retain.
Drafting and review without the blank-page problem
NDAs, engagement letters, leases, and employment agreements populate from your matter data. Contract review flags non-standard clauses for a human read. The final call stays with your attorneys.
Templates that fill themselves
Pull party names, dates, and matter details straight from your case management system. Output is consistent across the firm.
A second read on every contract
AI scans for missing clauses, off-market terms, and risk language. Attorneys see a flagged version, not a raw doc.
Capture every billable minute, finish research in seconds
Most firms lose 15-20% of billable time to manual tracking. We log it passively from your case files, email, and docs, then auto-generate invoices ready for partner review.
Passive time capture
Time logs build themselves from activity inside your case management software and email. No sticky notes, no end-of-week guessing.
Faster research and e-discovery prep
Summarize case law, surface relevant precedents, and pre-tag discovery documents. Your associates read the summary, then verify before citing.
